GROK 4.5 DELIVERS THE MOST POLISHED RESULTS IN REAL-WORLD TESTING
A new head-to-head test by Command Code put Grok 4.5, Fable 5, and GPT 5.5 through the exact same game-building challenge using identical prompts.
The outcome was clear:
•  Grok 4.5 produced a game that genuinely felt like a polished mobile title — smooth, finished, and well-executed.
•  Fable 5 and GPT 5.5 felt rushed, with mechanics that lacked refinement and overall polish.
Final ranking based on developer experience and final quality:
•  Grok 4.5: 9/10
•  Fable 5: 7.5/10
•  GPT 5.5: 7/10
This lines up with what many are noticing — Grok 4.5 often excels when the goal isn’t just speed, but actually delivering clean, high-quality, production-ready output.
Real-world tests like this continue to show Grok 4.5’s strength in practical, creative development tasks.

GROK 4.5 RANKS #1 ON REAL-WORLD PROFESSIONAL TASKS

New evaluation from Snorkel AI shows Grok 4.5 outperforming other frontier models on actual professional work.

On their GDPval+ benchmark (expert-created workplace reasoning tasks across multiple industries):

•  Grok 4.5: 29% mean pass rate
•  GPT 5.5: 22%
•  Claude Opus 4.8: 21%
Grok 4.5 showed particularly strong results in high-judgment areas like legal work, education, healthcare, and quality analysis.
While raw benchmark leaderboards remain competitive at the very top, Grok 4.5 is currently delivering the strongest performance on real professional deliverables.
This aligns with xAI’s focus on building models optimized for practical, high-value work rather than just synthetic tests.

GROK 4.5 TAKES #1 AMONG NON-ANTHROPIC MODELS ON NEW AGENTIC BENCHMARK
According to Artificial Analysis, Grok 4.5 ranks as the top non-Anthropic model on their new AA-Briefcase benchmark.
This test evaluates real-world agentic knowledge work — handling complex, multi-week professional projects with thousands of files to deliver reports, analysis, spreadsheets, and presentations.
Key highlights:
•  Highest Elo score among non-Claude models
•  Strong performance on correctness and analysis
•  Significantly cheaper ($1.12 per task) and faster than top competitors
While Anthropic models still lead overall on some general benchmarks, Grok 4.5 is delivering the best practical agentic performance outside of Claude right now — at a much better price.
